title: 菊花賞の後に・溢れる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin is defeated by Biwa Hayahide's overwhelming abilities in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both her loss and the difficulties she faced in training weigh heavily on her, and she breaks from mental and physical exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She confesses that she needs a break from both training and racing.
